preview.text: Auckland won the toss and chose to bowl first against Wellington in a one-day match at Basin Reserve, where the usual first-innings score in the 6 recorded one-day matches is 256. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 29 per cent chance of rain and about 20 degrees.

summary.text: Wellington won by 28 runs. WEL made 205-10, Callum McLachlan (wk) top-scoring with 55 off 59 balls; Angus Olliver took 4 for 42. AKL made 168-8, Siddhesh Dixit top-scoring with 38 off 58 balls; Henry Shipley took 2 for 33. Sides batting first at Basin Reserve usually make about 256.
